beats.line: I can't tell you whether to buy Diginex shares. That decision is yours alone.
beats.action: A single halftone stack of paper sheets drops onto open violet ground and settles square.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] I can't tell you whether to buy Diginex shares. That decision is yours alone.

beats.line: My job is to surface the evidence: the bull case, the bear case, risks and catalysts.
beats.headline: BULL AND BEAR
beats.action: The clear ground takes a new headline chip as the sheet stack fans into four sheets; a paper hand enters and taps each in turn, a violet ribbon running from the stack to the hand.
beats.delivery: My job is to surface the evidence: the bull case, the bear case, risks and catalysts.

beats.line: The bull case starts with regulation. Climate and sustainability rules are creating structural demand for this software.
beats.headline: REGULATORY DEMAND
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the pointing hand folds down into a paper bar chart; stacked grid-paper sheets pile up behind it, an orange ribbon running from the bar chart to a paper coin stack.
beats.delivery: The bull case starts with regulation. Climate and sustainability rules are creating structural demand for this software.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year, to two million dollars in the first half.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper bar chart's bars grow tall and hold; a coin-sized cream tag reading '293%' sits beside the orange ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year, to two million dollars in the first half.

beats.line: An October warrant exercise raised thirteen point eight million, extending runway. Market cap sits at thirty-four million.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart's tallest bar topples into a paper coin stack at the far end of the orange ribbon, and the stack settles.
beats.delivery: An October warrant exercise raised thirteen point eight million, extending runway. Market cap sits at thirty-four million.

beats.line: Cash was one point eight five million at the end of September, against burn near one point three million monthly.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the coin stack shrinks coin by coin on magenta ground; a black string runs from the coin stack to a paper calendar strip, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '1.4 months' sits beside it with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Cash was one point eight five million at the end of September, against burn near one point three million monthly.

beats.line: Execution risk is severe. Four acquisitions absorbed, and general costs rose to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the coin stack splits into four leaning piles; torn paper strips slide in above them and stack, the black string still in place to the calendar strip.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Execution risk is severe. Four acquisitions absorbed, and general costs rose to eight point one million.

beats.line: Resulticks remains in limbo, conditional on debt financing. Two other deals have stalled.
beats.headline: DEALS STALLED
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the torn strip tears twice more and the pieces drift apart, none reaching the coin stack, the black string sagging between them.
beats.delivery: Resulticks remains in limbo, conditional on debt financing. Two other deals have stalled.

beats.line: Before committing capital, demand cross-sell traction, a Resulticks closure, and operating leverage as losses narrow.
beats.headline: WHAT TO SEE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right edge as the torn strips gather and press back into the sheet stack on violet ground; a paper calendar page lands beside it, a cream ribbon running from the stack to the page.
beats.delivery: Before committing capital, demand cross-sell traction, a Resulticks closure, and operating leverage as losses narrow.

beats.headline: HIGH-RISK BET
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the calendar page is pinned onto the sheet stack, which fills the frame and holds, the cream ribbon still in place.
beats.delivery: The next earnings report is critical. This is a high-conviction, high-risk bet on execution, not a defensive holding.
